name: Craftsman's Writ: Draught of Water Breathing
summary: A transferable writ requests one Draught of Water Breathing and gives delivery and payment details. You need the writ to complete the exchange.

sections.title: A Written Request
sections.body: The faded note asks you for one Draught of Water Breathing. It also gives the delivery place and payment, and can pass from one holder to another.

faq.answer: It requests one Draught of Water Breathing.
The writ gives a delivery location, marked on your map.
The writ includes information about payment.
Yes. The note says the writ can be transferred.

faq.q: Do I need the writ to complete the exchange?
faq.answer: Yes. You must have the writ with you to complete the transaction.
